title: Tool-calling retrieval versus vector RAG for a small Greek--English knowledge base: accuracy and robustness to how users type Greek
title_zh: 针对小型希腊语-英语知识库：工具调用检索与向量增强生成（RAG）的对比——准确性及对用户希腊语输入方式的鲁棒性

paragraphs.en: Assistants grounded in a small, frequently edited knowledge base can retrieve through tool calls to a live data interface or through vector retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). We compare the two on KyGround, a benchmark of 198 questions drawn from the published records of a Greek–English agricultural platform on Kythera, Greece, with answers verified automatically against the records and each question posed in up to nine forms, including Greek without accents, in capitals and in three Latin-script (Greeklish) schemes. With Claude Haiku 4.5 as router and answer model, a reconstruction of the platform’s tool agent answered 71.6% of canonical Greek questions correctly and vector RAG 95.3% (difference − 23.6 -23.6 percentage points, 95% CI − 33.1 -33.1 to − 15.1 -15.1 ). Letting the router write the vector query changed nothing, and placing the whole knowledge base of about 26,000 tokens in the prompt reached 99.3%. The tool agent’s losses arose in retrieval. Its literal searches returned nothing when the router’s arguments did not occur verbatim in a record, for example when it transliterated Greek into Latin script or combined words that occur in a record but not as one phrase, and the agent then abstained. Unaccented and capitalised questions cost the tool agent about 20 points and vector RAG at most 2; accent-insensitive search removed this loss, and matching stemmed tokens raised the tool agent to 83.8% on canonical Greek. Greeklish cost both designs about 21 to 32 points. Tool interfaces for community knowledge bases need search that tolerates how users type.
paragraphs.zh: 基于小型且频繁编辑的知识库的智能体，可以通过工具调用访问实时数据接口，或通过向量检索增强生成（RAG）进行信息检索。 我们在 KyGround 上对这两种方法进行了比较。KyGround 是一个基准测试，包含从希腊基西拉岛一个希腊语-英语农业平台公开记录中抽取的 198 个问题。这些问题答案均通过自动比对原始记录验证，且每个问题以多达九种形式提出，包括无重音符号的希腊语、大写字母形式以及三种拉丁字母（希腊lish）方案。 使用 Claude Haiku 4.5 作为路由器和回答模型时，该平台工具智能体的重建版本正确回答了 71.6% 的标准希腊语问题，而向量 RAG 的正确率为 95.3%（差异为 −23.6 个百分点，95% 置信区间为 −33.1 至 −15.1）。 让路由器编写向量查询并未改变结果，而将整个约 26,000 个词符的知识库直接放入提示中后，正确率达到了 99.3%。 工具智能体的性能损失源于检索环节。 当路由器的参数在记录中未完全逐字出现时，其字面搜索会返回空结果；例如，当它将希腊语转写为拉丁字母，或组合了记录中存在但未以特定短语形式出现的词语时，该智能体便会放弃回答。 无重音符号和大写字母形式的问题使工具智能体的得分损失约 20 分，而向量 RAG 最多仅损失 2 分；采用不敏感于重音符号的搜索可消除这一损失，而对词根匹配则使工具智能体在标准希腊语问题上的正确率提升至 83.8%。 希腊lish形式的问题使两种设计的得分均损失约 21 至 32 分。 面向社区知识库的工具接口需要能够容忍用户不同输入方式的检索功能。

paragraphs.en: Smallholder farmers on remote islands need advice that is local. Which varieties grow on the island, when the harvest starts there, which producer sells what. Large language models (LLMs) can widen access to such advice, provided that their answers are anchored in authoritative local information rather than in the model’s parametric memory [ Tzachor et al., 2023 , High et al., 2026 ] , and deployed agricultural assistants therefore combine LLMs with retrieval over curated content [ Singh et al., 2024 , Collis et al., 2025 ] . Most of the producers on Kythera and Antikythera who tried the deployed assistant whose design is studied here found it helpful, but fewer than a quarter would trust its answers without human verification [ Karachalios et al., 2026 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 偏远岛屿上的小农需要符合当地实际情况的建议。 哪些品种适合在岛上种植、何时开始收获、哪位生产者销售哪些产品等。 大型语言模型（LLM）可以扩大此类建议的可及性，前提是它们的答案以权威的地方信息为基础，而非依赖模型的参数化记忆 [ Tzachor et al., 2023 , High et al., 2026 ]；因此，部署的农业助手将 LLM 与对精选内容的检索相结合 [ Singh et al., 2024 , Collis et al., 2025 ]。 基西拉岛和安提基拉岛上大多数试用了本文所研究设计的助手的生产者认为它很有帮助，但不到四分之一的人愿意在没有人工验证的情况下信任其答案 [ Karachalios et al., 2026 ]。

paragraphs.en: There are two common ways of grounding an assistant in a knowledge base. Vector retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) splits documents into chunks, embeds and indexes them, and inserts the chunks nearest to the question into the prompt [ Lewis et al., 2020 , Karpukhin et al., 2020 ] . Tool-calling retrieval lets the model choose among functions that query a live data interface and write their arguments [ Yao et al., 2023 , Schick et al., 2023 ] , and the Model Context Protocol (MCP) standardises how such tools are offered to LLM applications [ Anthropic and MCP Contributors, 2025 ] . The assistant Falco eleonorae , deployed for the farmers and cooperatives of Kythera, Greece, uses tool calls. Its system article [ Tantaroudas et al., 2026a ] , of which an earlier version is available as a preprint [ Tantaroudas et al., 2026b ] , argues that for a small, curated and frequently edited knowledge base, exact queries to a read-only data interface are more faithful than nearest-neighbour search. The counter-argument concerns how users type. A tool agent depends on a router that picks the right tool and writes arguments that the interface’s matching accepts, which is fragile when Greek is typed without accents, in capitals or in Latin characters (“Greeklish”) [ Toumazatos et al., 2024 , Luo et al., 2026 ] , whereas multilingual embeddings, which place translations and paraphrases close together [ Chen et al., 2024 ] , may absorb such variation.
paragraphs.zh: 将智能体与知识库进行关联的常见方法有两种。 向量检索增强生成（RAG）将文档分割为片段，对其进行嵌入和索引，然后将与问题最接近的片段插入提示中 [ Lewis et al., 2020 , Karpukhin et al., 2020 ]。 工具调用检索允许模型在能够查询实时数据接口并编写其参数的函数中进行选择 [ Yao et al., 2023 , Schick et al., 2023 ]，而模型上下文协议（MCP）则标准化了此类工具向大型语言模型应用提供的方式 [ Anthropic and MCP Contributors, 2025 ]。 部署在希腊基西拉岛农民和合作社中的 Falco eleonorae 智能体使用了工具调用。 其系统论文 [ Tantaroudas et al., 2026a ]（早期版本以预印本形式发布 [ Tantaroudas et al., 2026b ]）认为，对于规模较小、经过精心整理且频繁编辑的知识库而言，对只读数据接口执行精确查询比最近邻搜索更为准确。 反方论点则关注用户输入文本的方式。 工具智能体依赖一个路由器来选择合适的工具并编写接口所能接受的参数；当用户输入不带重音符号、使用大写字母或拉丁字符（“希腊lish”）的希腊语时，这种机制会显得脆弱 [ Toumazatos et al., 2024 , Luo et al., 2026 ]，而多语言嵌入技术则能将不同语言的翻译和改写表达置于相近位置 [ Chen et al., 2024 ]，因此可能能够包容此类差异。

paragraphs.en: Retrieval and long contexts. RAG couples a generator with a retriever over a non-parametric memory [ Lewis et al., 2020 ] , usually dense passage retrieval [ Karpukhin et al., 2020 ] ; Wu et al. [2026] review its components and variants. Multilingual embedding models, such as the M3-Embedding model used here [ Chen et al., 2024 ] , place translations and paraphrases close together. When a corpus fits in the context window, long-context prompting outperformed RAG on average when resources allowed [ Li et al., 2024 ] , although models use information in the middle of a long context less reliably [ Liu et al., 2024 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 检索与长上下文。 RAG 将生成器与一个非参数化记忆库中的检索器相结合 [Lewis et al., 2020]，通常采用密集段落检索 [Karpukhin et al., 2020]；Wu 等人 [2026] 对其组件和变体进行了综述。 多语言嵌入模型（如本文使用的 M3-Embedding 模型 [Chen et al., 2024]）会将翻译和改写表达置于相近的位置。 当语料库能够完全容纳在上下文窗口内时，在资源允许的情况下，长上下文提示的平均表现优于 RAG [Li et al., 2024]，尽管模型对长上下文中间部分信息的利用可靠性较低 [Liu et al., 2024]。

paragraphs.en: Tool calling. ReAct interleaves reasoning with actions such as API calls [ Yao et al., 2023 ] , Toolformer learns when and how to call tools [ Schick et al., 2023 ] , and the Berkeley Function Calling Leaderboard evaluates function calling from single calls to agentic use [ Patil et al., 2025 ] . Because the router selects tools from their descriptions, description quality matters [ Hasan et al., 2026 ] , and with multilingual input, models often fill tool parameters with values in the user’s language, which breaks interfaces that expect a fixed one [ Luo et al., 2026 ] . Generating executable queries rather than retrieving passages suits structured information [ Hontan et al., 2026 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 工具调用。 ReAct 将推理与 API 调用等动作交替进行 [ Yao et al., 2023 ]，Toolformer 学习何时以及如何调用工具 [ Schick et al., 2023 ]，而 Berkeley 函数调用排行榜则评估从单次调用到智能体式使用的函数调用能力 [ Patil et al., 2025 ]。 由于路由器根据工具描述来选择工具，因此描述的质量至关重要 [ Hasan et al., 2026 ]；而在多语言输入的情况下，模型常常用用户语言中的值来填充工具参数，这会破坏那些期望固定语言的接口 [ Luo et al., 2026 ]。 生成可执行的查询而非检索段落更适合结构化信息 [ Hontan et al., 2026 ]。

sents.en: Because the router selects tools from their descriptions, description quality matters [ Hasan et al., 2026 ] , and with multilingual input, models often fill tool parameters with values in the user’s language, which breaks interfaces that expect a fixed one [ Luo et al., 2026 ] .

sents.en: Generating executable queries rather than retrieving passages suits structured information [ Hontan et al., 2026 ] .
sents.zh: 生成可执行的查询而非检索段落更适合结构化信息 [ Hontan et al., 2026 ]。

paragraphs.en: Greek and Greeklish. Greek users often type without accents, in capitals or in Latin characters. Greeklish has no single mapping, so one word can be written in many ways, and even native speakers can find it hard to read [ Toumazatos et al., 2024 ] . The formal transliteration is ISO 843 [ ISO, 1997 ] , but informal phonetic and visual schemes dominate in messages. Open Greek LLMs [ Voukoutis et al., 2024 , Roussis et al., 2025 ] and Greek retrieval benchmarks [ Beta et al., 2026 ] are emerging, but we know of no head-to-head comparison of tool-calling and vector retrieval in Greek, with the orthographic variation that Greek users produce.
paragraphs.zh: 希腊语与希腊lish。 希腊用户常常不加重音符号、使用大写字母或拉丁字母输入。 希腊lish没有统一的映射规则，因此一个词可能有多种写法，甚至母语者也可能难以阅读 [ Toumazatos et al., 2024 ]。 正式的转写标准是 ISO 843 [ ISO, 1997 ]，但非正式的声音和视觉转写方案在信息交流中更为普遍。 开放式的希腊语 LLM [ Voukoutis et al., 2024 , Roussis et al., 2025 ] 和希腊语检索基准 [ Beta et al., 2026 ] 正在兴起，但我们尚未发现任何关于工具调用与向量检索在希腊语中的直接对比研究，尤其考虑到希腊用户造成的拼写变体问题。

paragraphs.en: The DASK platform serves the Kythera pilot of the PoliRURAL Plus project [ PoliRURAL Plus Consortium, 2024 ] . Its editors maintain bilingual, Greek-primary records of crops, seasonal-calendar entries, glossary entries (including dialect terms), products, agritourism experiences, training modules, articles and frequently asked questions, and a read-only interface serves the published records with server-side editorial gating [ Tantaroudas et al., 2026a ] . paragraphs.en: KyGround release contains 198 items including 121 generated from 19 bilingual templates over typed fields (for example the harvest period of a crop or the duration of an experience) and 77 written individually, including aggregations across records. Fourteen items ask for information that the knowledge base does not contain, and twelve for a price that is shown only on request. Each answer is a set of typed facts (text, list members, numbers, ranges, durations, months, price on request, abstention), and an answer is correct when it contains every required fact. Every item was verified automatically against the snapshot, without a model in the loop. Its gold records exist and are published, template items regenerate exactly, every gold fact and every quoted piece of evidence occurs in the records, and aggregates recompute to the same records. Items about the same record share a cluster. A development split of 40 items, made of whole groups of connected records, was used only to tune vector RAG, and the primary analysis set consists of the 148 answerable test items in 79 clusters. Each item was posed in canonical Greek, English, Greek without accents, Greek in capitals, three Greeklish schemes (a transcription in the style of ELOT 743 and ISO 843, an informal phonetic scheme and an informal visual scheme that uses digits and look-alike letters), other inflection and colloquial or regional wording (Table 1 ). Other-inflection paraphrases exist for 8 items and colloquial or regional variants for 75, so the release contains 1,469 queries.
paragraphs.zh: KyGround 发布版本包含 198 个项目，其中包括根据 19 个双语模板在带类型字段中生成的 121 个项目（例如作物的收获期或体验的持续时间），以及单独编写的 77 个项目，包括跨记录的聚合项。 有 14 个项目要求知识库中不存在的信息，另有 12 个项目要求仅在请求时显示的价格。 每个答案都是一组带类型的事实（文本、列表成员、数字、范围、持续时间、月份、请求时提供的价格、拒绝回答），当答案包含所有必要事实时即为正确。 每个项目都通过与快照自动比对进行了验证，过程中没有使用模型。 其黄金记录存在且已发布，模板项目能够精确再生，每个黄金事实和每个引用的证据均出现在记录中，并且聚合项重新计算后也能得到相同的记录。 关于同一记录的项目共享一个聚类。 开发集包含 40 个项目，由完整的关联记录组构成，仅用于调整向量 RAG；主要分析集则由 79 个聚类中的 148 个可回答的测试项目组成。 每个项目均以标准希腊语、英语、无重音符号的希腊语、大写希腊语以及三种希腊lish方案（一种遵循 ELOT 743 和 ISO 843 风格的转写方案、一种非正式语音方案和一种使用数字与相似字母的非正式视觉方案）提出，此外还包括其他屈折形式及口语化或地域性表达（表 1）。 其中 8 个项目存在其他屈折形式的改写版本，75 个项目存在口语化或地域性变体，因此该发布版本共包含 1,469 条查询。

paragraphs.en: All six conditions (Table 2 ) use Claude Haiku 4.5 [ Anthropic, 2025 ] as router and answer model and share the base prompt and the knowledge base. C2 reconstructs the deployed tool agent. The router selects up to two of nine tools (knowledge search, crop information, seasonal calendar, glossary, products, experiences, cooperatives, training modules and lesson content) and fills their arguments, and an in-process replica of the data interface executes them with its gating, Greek fallback and matching. The interface’s free-text matching was characterised before the runs with 50 probes of the platform’s public training-module search. It ignored case and matched within words, but it was sensitive to accents, word order and inflection and did not match Greeklish, and the replica was set to the same behaviour (phrase matching with case folding). C1 embeds bilingually serialised chunks of at most 800 characters with BGE-M3 [ Chen et al., 2024 ] and inserts the eight nearest to the question, settings chosen on the development split by the share of gold records retrieved, without model calls. C1q differs from C1 only in that the router model writes the search query, through a single search tool with the same name and query description as the knowledge search of C2, so C1q and C2 share the model, the prompt and the function-calling mechanism and differ in what the call retrieves. C3 gives the answer model both the tool results of C2 and the chunks of C1. C4 places the whole knowledge base in the prompt and shows what the answer model achieves when no evidence can be missed, and C0 answers without retrieval. In an ablation, C2 answered all Greek and Greeklish forms with the replica’s free-text search set to (a) phrase matching with case folding, the platform’s behaviour, (b) phrase matching with accents also removed and (c) matching of all stemmed tokens.
paragraphs.zh: 所有六个条件（表2）均使用 Claude Haiku 4.5 [Anthropic, 2025] 作为路由器和回答模型，并共享基础提示词和知识库。 C2 重建了已部署的工具智能体。 路由器从九种工具（知识搜索、作物信息、季节性日历、术语表、产品、体验、合作社、培训模块和课程内容）中选择最多两种，并填写其参数；数据接口的实时副本则通过其门控机制、希腊语回退策略和匹配逻辑执行这些工具。 在运行前，通过平台公开培训模块搜索的50条探针，对接口自由文本匹配功能进行了特征分析。 该匹配功能忽略大小写并在单词内部进行匹配，但对重音符号、词序和屈折变化敏感，且不匹配希腊语化拼写；副本也被设置为相同的行为（短语匹配并折叠大小写）。 C1 使用 BGE-M3 [Chen et al., 2024] 对最多800个字符的双语序列化片段进行嵌入，并将与问题最相关的八个片段插入提示中；相关设置基于开发集上检索到的黄金记录比例选定，且无需模型调用。 C1q 与 C1 的唯一区别在于：其路由模型通过一个搜索工具编写搜索查询，该工具的名称和查询描述与 C2 的知识搜索工具相同；因此 C1q 和 C2 共享模型、提示词和函数调用机制，但调用所检索的内容不同。 C3 将 C2 的工具结果和 C1 的片段一并提供给回答模型。 C4 将整个知识库置于提示中，以展示在无法遗漏任何证据的情况下回答模型的表现；而 C0 则无需检索即可作答。 在一项消融实验中，C2 对所有的希腊语及希腊语化拼写形式进行了回答，其副本的自由文本搜索分别设置为：(a) 短语匹配并折叠大小写（平台默认行为），(b) 移除重音符号后的短语匹配，以及 (c) 对所有词干化词元进行匹配。

paragraphs.en: No model was called through an API. Replies were generated by sub-agents of a Claude agent session run on the authors’ subscription, each in its own context window [ Anthropic, n.d. ] . Every request was keyed by the hash of its content and looked up in a cache, and unanswered requests were exported in batches, answered by Claude Haiku 4.5 sub-agents and validated. Check codes placed every 100 lines of a batch, introduced after two early batches of full-context (C4) requests were found to have been read only in part, verified that a sub-agent had read its whole batch. The earlier batches of other requests, whose replies had each been matched to their request, were kept. Because a sub-agent sees every request of its batch, all replies were audited for facts or records that occurred in another request of the batch but not in their own. The 99 flagged replies of the whole study (1.1% of 9,079 requests) were generated again in isolation, one request per sub-agent, and the results below use these replies. The audit, the withdrawal rule and an isolation control were added after the results had been seen. The withdrawal rule, which covered every flagged reply whatever its grade, was fixed before any regenerated reply was seen. The protocol, hypotheses and analysis plan were fixed, and their digests recorded, before any run with a real model. As the protocol was not deposited in a registry, the study is pre-specified rather than pre-registered.

paragraphs.en: The gold record was among the retrieved records for 75.7% of the answers of C2 to canonical Greek and English questions, against 98.6% for C1 (Figure 2 ). In an exploratory analysis, its accuracy depended on whether the question quoted a record’s exact title. It answered 81.9% of the 105 canonical Greek questions that did and 46.5% of the 43 that did not, against 97.1% and 90.7% for C1. The router’s arguments show why searches failed (an exploratory analysis). paragraphs.en: With one router and answer model, vector RAG answered questions about a small, community-edited knowledge base more accurately than tool retrieval, and the controls locate the difference. C1q gave vector retrieval the same router model, prompt and function-calling mechanism as C2 and changed nothing, and C4 shows that the answer model answers almost every question when the evidence is present, so retrieval was the bottleneck. The tool agent’s literal search returned nothing when the router’s arguments did not occur verbatim in a record (a transliterated or translated keyword, an accent added to a title stored in capitals, or keywords that occur in a record but not as one phrase), and the agent then abstained. Multilingual input is known to make models fill tool parameters in an unexpected language [ Luo et al., 2026 ] . Here the router transliterated Greek into Latin script even though the questions and the records were Greek.

paragraphs.en: Three lessons follow for tool interfaces over small community knowledge bases. First, free-text search should ignore case, accents and the final sigma and match stemmed tokens rather than literal phrases. In the replica, this removed the whole loss on unaccented and capitalised questions and recovered about half of the gap to vector RAG on canonical Greek. Second, arguments should be in the script of the records, and the tool description alone did not ensure it. The search tool asked for terms preferably in Greek, yet the router wrote 28.7% of its free-text arguments for canonical Greek questions in Latin script. Third, Greeklish remains hard for both designs. The vector RAG reached 68.2% to 74.3% on Greeklish questions, 21 to 27 points below its canonical accuracy, against about 40% for the tool agent, so a vector fallback would raise the tool agent’s Greeklish accuracy without solving Greeklish, and transliteration-aware matching remains to be tested. On canonical questions, adding vector chunks to the tool results (C3) matched the accuracy of vector RAG. For a knowledge base of about 26,000 tokens, placing everything in the prompt was the most accurate design, at about four times the input of the tool agent, and the risk of overlooking evidence in the middle of a long context [ Liu et al., 2024 ] did not materialise at this size.
paragraphs.zh: 针对小型知识库的工具接口有三条经验教训。 首先，自由文本搜索应忽略大小写、重音符号和末尾的 sigma 字母，并匹配词干形式而非字面短语。 在复制系统中，这一改动消除了未加重音和首字母大写的提问所带来的全部损失，并将与标准希腊语向量 RAG 之间的差距缩小了约一半。 其次，论点应采用记录中的脚本形式，而仅靠工具说明无法确保这一点。 搜索工具要求术语最好使用希腊语，但路由系统在标准希腊语问题中仍有 28.7% 的自由文本论点以拉丁字母书写。 第三，Greeklish 对两种设计而言仍然具有挑战性。 向量 RAG 在 Greeklish 问题上的准确率达到 68.2% 至 74.3%，比其标准希腊语准确率低了 21 到 27 个百分点；相比之下，工具智能体的准确率约为 40%。因此，采用向量回退机制虽能提升工具智能体处理 Greeklish 的准确率，但并未解决 Greeklish 本身的问题，且需要进一步测试是否支持转写相关的匹配。 在标准希腊语问题上，将向量分块添加到工具结果中（C3）的准确率与向量 RAG 相当。 对于一个约含 26,000 个词元的知识库而言，将所有内容直接放入提示的设计准确率最高，但其输入量约为工具智能体的四倍；此外，在如此规模的文本中忽略中间证据的风险 [ Liu et al., 2024 ] 并未实际出现。

sents.zh: 其次，论点应采用记录中的脚本形式，而仅靠工具说明无法确保这一点。

sents.en: The search tool asked for terms preferably in Greek, yet the router wrote 28.7% of its free-text arguments for canonical Greek questions in Latin script.
sents.zh: 搜索工具要求术语最好使用希腊语，但路由系统在标准希腊语问题中仍有 28.7% 的自由文本论点以拉丁字母书写。

sents.en: Third, Greeklish remains hard for both designs.
sents.zh: 第三，Greeklish 对两种设计而言仍然具有挑战性。

sents.en: The vector RAG reached 68.2% to 74.3% on Greeklish questions, 21 to 27 points below its canonical accuracy, against about 40% for the tool agent, so a vector fallback would raise the tool agent’s Greeklish accuracy without solving Greeklish, and transliteration-aware matching remains to be tested.
sents.zh: 向量 RAG 在 Greeklish 问题上的准确率达到 68.2% 至 74.3%，比其标准希腊语准确率低了 21 到 27 个百分点；相比之下，工具智能体的准确率约为 40%。因此，采用向量回退机制虽能提升工具智能体处理 Greeklish 的准确率，但并未解决 Greeklish 本身的问题，且需要进一步测试是否支持转写相关的匹配。

sents.en: On canonical questions, adding vector chunks to the tool results (C3) matched the accuracy of vector RAG.
sents.zh: 在标准希腊语问题上，将向量分块添加到工具结果中（C3）的准确率与向量 RAG 相当。

sents.en: For a knowledge base of about 26,000 tokens, placing everything in the prompt was the most accurate design, at about four times the input of the tool agent, and the risk of overlooking evidence in the middle of a long context [ Liu et al., 2024 ] did not materialise at this size.
sents.zh: 对于一个约含 26,000 个词元的知识库而言，将所有内容直接放入提示的设计准确率最高，但其输入量约为工具智能体的四倍；此外，在如此规模的文本中忽略中间证据的风险 [ Liu et al., 2024 ] 并未实际出现。

paragraphs.en: Limitations. The authors built the system evaluated as C2 and the platform from which the benchmark was drawn. To limit bias, the protocol was fixed before the runs, the primary scoring is deterministic and all outputs are available on request, and on accuracy the results run against the system article’s claim. Claude Haiku 4.5 replaced the deployed GPT-5-family models [ OpenAI, 2025 ] , so the accuracies estimate what the designs achieve with this model rather than the deployed system’s accuracy, and another router may transliterate more or less often. C2 is a reconstruction. Seven of the nine tool names, all nine tool descriptions and the full system prompt were reconstructed. Its router saw only the nine local tools, whereas the production router also chooses among the upstream agent’s general tools, and the replica’s agreement with the deployed interface could not be measured. The judge is from the same model family as the answer model, so a shared preference for the family’s phrasing cannot be excluded, serving only as a second scorer. The questions were derived from the records rather than collected from users, and 105 of the 148 primary questions quote a record’s exact title, which favours literal matching, so the tool agent’s accuracy on users’ own wording may be lower than reported. The gold answers were verified against the records rather than by the platform’s editors. The knowledge base is small and comes from one platform. Batched generation contaminated 1.1% of replies, and the audit detects only borrowed facts, records and markers. Generation in a session cannot be repeated token for token, each query was answered once, and the study can detect differences of about 14 points with 80% power, so the smaller differences between the Greeklish gaps are reported as estimates.

paragraphs.en: For a small Greek–English knowledge base, vector RAG answered 95% of canonical Greek questions correctly and tool retrieval 72%. The gap arose in literal search, widened with unaccented and capitalised Greek and was partly closed by accent-insensitive, stemmed matching in the data interface, while Greeklish remained hard for both designs. Tool interfaces should be evaluated in the spellings that users actually type.
paragraphs.zh: 对于一个小型的希腊语-英语知识库，向量 RAG 正确回答了 95% 的标准希腊语问题，而工具检索的正确率为 72%。 这种差距出现在逐字搜索中，随着未重音和首字母大写的希腊语出现而扩大；数据接口中不敏感于重音的词干匹配部分弥补了这一差距，但希腊lish对两种设计来说仍然难以处理。 工具接口应当基于用户实际输入的拼写形式进行评估。
